AIMA 430.name: AI Capstone I: Project Design
AIMA 430.description: First of a two-semester capstone: mapping real-world problems to AI solutions and prototyping initial solutions using problem-solving methods and machine learning.

AIMA 440.name: AI Capstone II: Project Implementation
AIMA 440.description: Second of a two-semester capstone: evaluating and enhancing the AIMA 430 prototype toward real-world deployment, assessing performance, ethical implications, and reproducibility.
